notes: paired HUB + ACE 1500, manual -500W: the ACE draws exactly 500W from the grid, the HUB only stores its own 300W solar
paired HUB + ACE 1500, manual -1900W: the ACE is capped at its 900W input limit, the HUB gets no grid power
paired HUB + ACE 1500, manual -300W, no solar: the idle ACE (no charging telemetry) is still commanded and draws 300W
paired HUB + ACE 1500, empty battery, manual -500W: an empty battery grid-charges through the ACE
paired HUB + ACE 1500, full battery, manual -500W: nothing is charged, the HUB bypasses its 300W solar to the home
paired HUB + ACE 1500, manual +600W: the HUB covers it (300W solar + 300W battery), the ACE is not commanded

paired HUB + ACE 1500, manual +1500W: the HUB runs at its 1200W limit, the ACE is never started as a second discharger (XFAIL: grid_feeders was removed, so the idle ACE is started and also delivers 480W)
